newsletter.title: TorxFlow Weekly Automotive Newsletter
newsletter.subtitle: Practical updates for European independent garages

articles.title: What do thinner oils mean for filters?
articles.summary: Choosing a high-quality filter could be the most effective way of preventing catastrophic engine failure, strengthening a workshop’s hard-earned reputation.
articles.imagePrompt: Close-up of an oil filter being installed in a modern engine with droplets of thin synthetic oil visible, emphasizing filtration.
articles.imageAlt: Mechanic installing an oil filter in a car engine, with thin oil droplets highlighted.

articles.title: Investeren in kalibreren - Aftersales Magazine
articles.summary: As more vehicles equip increasing ADAS systems, the newsletter questions whether workshops invest enough in calibration, posing this to the Aftersales panel.
articles.imagePrompt: Mechanic using a calibration tool on a car's windshield-mounted camera, showing ADAS sensor alignment.
articles.imageAlt: Technician calibrating a forward-facing camera on a vehicle's windshield for ADAS systems.

articles.title: Volgende generatie aan het roer van Möller Autoschade - Aftersales Magazine
articles.summary: Jolique Möller has taken over daily management and shares of the Möller Autoschade Group from her parents Alfred and Magchelina Möller.
articles.imagePrompt: Younger woman shaking hands with older parents in front of an auto body shop garage, symbolizing succession.
articles.imageAlt: Jolique Möller shaking hands with her parents outside the Möller Autoschade workshop.

articles.title: France urges Renault, Stellantis to keep parts sourcing local | Automotive World
articles.summary: France owns stakes in both of the OEMs it is pressuring, but are they enough to outweigh the cost arithmetic of deeper Chinese ties? By Stewart Burnett
articles.imagePrompt: Map of France with factory icons and parts supply lines showing local sourcing versus overseas.
articles.imageAlt: Illustration of French government encouraging local parts sourcing for Renault and Stellantis factories.

articles.title: How is Mann-Filter adapting to new technology
articles.summary: Mann-Filter explains its response to evolving filter technology in the UK market, highlighting rapid changes in vehicle filtration and implications for workshops.
articles.imagePrompt: Series of different vehicle filters (oil, air, cabin) displayed on a workbench with digital readouts showing tech advancements.
articles.imageAlt: Various Mann-Filter products on a mechanic's bench with digital indicators of new filter technology.
